segments.thig6.6:1.3: Yo maṃ dukkhā pamocesi, aññañca bahukaṃ janaṃ.
segments.thig6.6:2.3: Bhāvito aṭṭhaṅgiko [ariyaṭṭhaṅgiko (sī. ka.), bhāvitaṭṭhaṅgiko (syā.)] maggo, nirodho phusito mayā.
segments.thig6.6:3.1: “Mātā putto pitā bhātā, ayyakā ca pure ahuṃ;
segments.thig6.6:4.1: “Diṭṭho hi me so bhagavā, antimoyaṃ samussayo;
segments.thig6.6:5.3: Samagge sāvake passe, esā buddhāna vandanā.
segments.thig6.6:6.1: “Bahūnaṃ [bahunnaṃ (sī. syā.)] vata atthāya, māyā janayi gotamaṃ;

lines: “Bahūnaṃ vata atthāyā”ti osānagāthāyapi satthu lokassa bahūpakārataṃyeva vibhāveti.
Yaṃ panettha atthato na vibhattaṃ, taṃ suviññeyyameva.
